name: JackMcGuireAstro.github.io: CTAS and WorldsIndex
description: Static research site hosting CTAS (the Continuous Transient Alert Snapshot: a certified, source-complete aggregation of public transient and multimessenger records with per-source query receipts) and WorldsIndex (an exoplanet and host-star index with per-source identity states, conflict sets and transit ephemerides). Both are built every cycle by GitHub Actions and served as checksum-bound static files with IVOA-format exports (ECSV, VOTable 1.5, VOParquet, DataLink 1.1), an OpenAPI 3.1 description of the static endpoints and W3C PROV-JSON provenance per build. Repository metadata only: no data release has been published and no DOI has been minted.
